description: Source code for a command-line tool 'dump_syms_tool.cc' that uses the DumpSymbols class to generate Breakpad symbol files from Mach-O files, with support for handling split modules and architecture-specific CFI data.

classes.name: Options
classes.description: Holds command-line options such as source path, dSYM path, architecture, and flags for CFI and inter-CU references.

methods.name: StackFrameEntryComparator
methods.description: Comparator function for sorting Module::StackFrameEntry pointers by address.

methods.name: CopyCFIDataBetweenModules
methods.description: Copies non-overlapping CFI data from one Module to another.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Main processing function that reads Mach-O and dSYM files, handles architecture selection, and writes the symbol data.

methods.name: Usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command-line tool.

methods.name: SetupOptions
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and sets options accordingly.
